ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Two dice with volumes $V$ and $W$ intersect each other as shown. $90 \%$ of the volume of the die with volume $V$ does not belong to both dice. $85 \%$ of the volume of the die with volume $W$ does not belong to both dice. What is the relationship between the volumes of the two dice?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows two cubic dice penetrating into each other and overlapping: on the left is a cube, and on the right is a tilted cube; they share the same intersecting solid region in the middle. Reasoning: Let the common intersection volume of the two dice be I. The problem says that 90% of the die with volume V does not belong to the common part of the two dice, so what belongs to the intersection is 10%, namely I = 0.10V. The problem also says that 85% of the die with volume W does not belong to the common part, so what belongs to the intersection is 15%, namely I = 0.15W. Since this is the same common intersection volume, obtain 0.10V = 0.15W. Therefore V/W = 0.15/0.10 = 3/2, so V = 3/2 W.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as two cube-shaped dice penetrating/overlapping, with the shared solid region being the same physical volume for both dice. From the text, interpret '90% of the volume of the die with volume V does not belong to both dice' as meaning only 10% of V is in the intersection. Likewise, '85% of the volume of the die with volume W does not belong to both dice' means 15% of W is in the intersection. Let the common intersection volume be I. Then I = 0.10V and also I = 0.15W. Equate the two expressions: 0.10V = 0.15W, so V/W = 0.15/0.10 = 3/2. Conclude V = 3/2 W.
